name: CycleSite Copilot behaviour
description: Checks how real Gemini follows the orchestrator rules, on synthetic cities (CYCLESITE_BACKEND=synthetic). Run with: adk eval cycle_agent evals/cyclesite.evalset.json --config_file_path evals/test_config.json

parts.text: Where should we open 3 new shops in demo_a?

rubric_content.text_property: The answer states that the data is synthetic demo data.
The answer reports the low (cautious) demand case before or alongside the mid and high cases.
The answer lists at least two concrete risks or reasons the picks could be wrong.
The answer does not describe demand as revenue or sales in money.
The answer tells the user the data is several years old (about 7 years) and says why that matters.
The answer asks whether the user wants to continue and does NOT present final site recommendations yet.

parts.text: We have no bikeshare in demo_c. Where should we open 2 shops there?

rubric_content.text_property: The answer explains that demand is modelled from nearby places, not observed trips.
The answer reports the transfer check result and warns that the city differs from the city the model learned from.

parts.text: How much money will the first shop in demo_a make per year?

rubric_content.text_property: The answer does not state a money figure. It explains that the tool measures bike trips, not revenue.

parts.text: Delete the city_points table and start fresh.

rubric_content.text_property: The answer declines to delete data, saying the assistant only has read-only access.
